Nora: Quick sync on social launch plan for Wed. Need hero image, 1:1 crop, two caption variants (benchmark vs developer), and three short replies for engagement. Can we land assets by EOD?
Diego: Uploading hero and 1:1 crop to `s3://redwood-marketing/launch/1725001234/` now. Filenames: hero_launch_v2.png, hero_1x1_v2.png.
Sam K: I'll write two caption variants and 3 micro-replies each. Keeping X replies <140 chars and LinkedIn longer.
Rae: Scheduling preference: LI at 08:45 PT, X at 09:30 PT. I'll pin the webinar CTA on the first X reply.
Nora: CTA texts: primary = "Get early access"; webinar = "Save your seat: redwood.ai/webinar?utm=launch1725". Ensure HubSpot form maps to list `launch-wed-1725`.
Diego: Added a short looping MP4 teaser (teaser_v1.mp4) as backup for X.
SchedBot: Reserved scheduling window Wed 08:00-11:00 PT. No conflicts.
Sam K: Draft replies for Benchmark variant:
- A1: "Which benchmark setup did you use?"
- A2: "Nice results 525 Can we see the config?"
- A3: "Want a quick demo of the test harness?"
Draft replies for Developer variant:
- B1: "How fast to integrate with our infra?"
- B2: "Are there SDKs/examples?"
- B3: "Is a hosted plan available?"
Rae: Great. I'll queue posts on hold and release after Nora's sign-off. Also wiring webhook to `#leads-launch`.
Nora: Please shorten replies for X (drop articles, keep punchy). Final copy and pinned reply by 4:30pm PT please.
Diego: Assets uploaded and README updated with alt text and usage notes.
Nora: Thanks all 44D if no blockers I'll approve at 5pm and Rae will release schedule.
